name: @hussmartinez/learn-sdk-example-native
description: An Expo application that plays learn-sdk content with the built @hussmartinez/learn-sdk/native and @hussmartinez/ui/native, to prove that Metro resolves the packages and Hermes compiles them (sdk-core ADR 0069).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=1 expo export --platform android --output-dir dist
